headline: MELVILLE'S NEW TALE OF THE WHALE ISSUED
dispatch: New York, Nov. 15. Harper & Brothers yesterday issued Herman Melville's Moby-Dick, a long sea tale centered on a whaling captain's pursuit of a white sperm whale. The volume appears in America after its earlier British issue and is offered in a single bound edition.
answer: Moby-Dick is published in the United States, 1851
